[1] Estate of the artist [1887–1986] (Santa Fe, New Mexico, USA); [2] 1993, Georgia O'Keeffe Foundation (Abiquiu, New Mexico, USA); [3] December 26, 1997, purchased by Jane Bradley Pettit Foundation (Milwaukee, Wisconsin, USA) and gift to Milwaukee Art Museum (Milwaukee, Wisconsin, USA) 
NOTES: 
[1], [2] Barbara Buhler Lynes, Georgia O'Keeffe: Catalogue Raisonné. Vol. 1 (New Haven, CT: Yale University Press; Washington, DC: National Gallery of Art; Abiquiu, NM: The Georgia O'Keeffe Foundation, 1999), pp. 150, 178, cat. 279, 331. 
[3] Agreement in MAM object file 
(Source: MAM, 2025)
remarks_1999: Whitney Archive indicates, "Exam. at Amer. Place, March 1946. . . . No signature [notes backing inscription 2, but identifies as OK] . . . One wonders whether this was the work that made Hartley write of O'Keeffe, 'She is impaled on white consciousness.' See gallery photograph, 2–c." [Hartley quotation is from *Adventures in the Arts* (1921)]. Abiquiú Notebooks notes backing inscriptions 1, 2. Pictured in 1923 New York (Anderson) Stieglitz installation photograph, see Appendix III, figure 13. Reproduced and titled *Abstraction* in *Vanity Fair* (October 1922). (Source: Lynes, 1999)
